title: AutoRA: Automated Research Assistant for Closed-Loop Empirical Research
focus_en: Connects experiment design, data collection, and scientific model discovery through replaceable experimentalist, experiment-runner, and theorist modules.
focus_zh: 通过可替换的实验设计、实验执行和理论建模模块，连接实验设计、数据收集与科学模型发现。
boundary_en: Users specify variables, experimental access, and model-discovery components; the framework does not itself establish autonomous selection of scientifically important questions.
boundary_zh: 用户需指定变量、实验接口与模型发现组件；该框架本身没有验证自主选择重要科学问题的能力。

title: Deep Adaptive Design: Amortizing Sequential Bayesian Experimental Design
focus_en: Learns a reusable experimental-design policy that maps previous observations to the next experiment and optimizes information gained across the full experiment sequence.
focus_zh: 学习可复用的 experimental-design policy，根据已有观测选择下一次实验，并优化整个实验序列的信息增益。
boundary_en: This is a Bayesian design foundation with a supplied likelihood, prior, and design space, rather than a demonstrated ability to invent new research goals or scientific model classes.
boundary_zh: 这是依赖给定 likelihood、prior 与设计空间的 Bayesian design 基础方法，尚不体现自主发明研究目标或科学模型类别的能力。

title: Automated Hypothesis Validation with Agentic Sequential Falsifications
focus_en: Uses agents to design and run tests of a supplied hypothesis's measurable implications. Combines test evidence sequentially using e-values.
focus_zh: 让智能体设计并执行检验，测试给定自然语言假设的可测量推论，再用 e-values 逐步汇总证据。
boundary_en: Evaluation uses existing datasets, and Type-I error control depends on valid logical implications and conditional tests; it does not establish false discovery rate control across many hypotheses.
boundary_zh: 评估使用已有数据集，Type-I error control 依赖有效的逻辑蕴含与条件检验；它没有验证跨多个假设的 false discovery rate control。

title: AIDE: AI-Driven Exploration in the Space of Code
focus_en: Treats ML experimentation as tree search over executable code, using measured results to choose whether to draft, debug, or improve candidate solutions.
focus_zh: 将 ML 实验建模为可执行代码空间中的 tree search，用实际测量结果决定生成、调试或改进哪个候选方案。
boundary_en: The goal, data, and optimization metric are supplied, so performance on Kaggle, MLE-bench, and RE-Bench measures execution and search rather than research-question significance.
boundary_zh: 目标、数据与优化指标由外部给定，因此 Kaggle、MLE-bench 和 RE-Bench 表现衡量的是执行与搜索能力，而非研究问题的重要性。

title: R&D-Agent: An LLM-Agent Framework Towards Autonomous Data Science
focus_en: Separates proposing and evaluating improvement ideas from implementing and debugging them, making the research-and-development loop easier to extend.
focus_zh: 将改进想法的提出与评价，同实现和调试分开，便于扩展迭代研发流程。
boundary_en: The linked report evaluates ML engineering on MLE-bench. Separate finance and fine-tuning papers in the repository do not establish autonomous scientific question selection for this work.
boundary_zh: 所链接报告评价 MLE-bench 上的 ML engineering。同一仓库中的金融和 fine-tuning 论文，不能为本工作证明自主科研选题能力。

title: Curie: Toward Rigorous and Automated Scientific Experimentation with AI Agents
focus_en: Coordinates planning and execution agents to reproduce, extend, or challenge computational findings. Checks the setup, controls task handoffs, and keeps structured experiment records.
focus_zh: 协调规划与执行智能体，复现、扩展或质疑计算实验结论；检查环境、控制任务交接，并保存结构化实验记录。
boundary_en: The study supplies questions and context in four computer-science domains. Its combined LLM and human evaluation does not formally guarantee scientific validity or demonstrate autonomous question selection.
boundary_zh: 研究给定四个计算机科学领域的问题和背景。LLM 与人工混合评价不能提供科学有效性的形式化保证，也未证明自主选题能力。

title: CORE-Bench: Fostering the Credibility of Published Research Through a Computational Reproducibility Agent Benchmark
focus_en: Evaluates computational reproducibility through installing dependencies, executing supplied scientific code, and interpreting its numerical or visual outputs.
focus_zh: 通过安装依赖、执行给定科学代码并解释数值或图像输出，评估 computational reproducibility。
boundary_en: It reproduces existing artifacts rather than choosing new questions; the original harness is unmaintained and its recommended HAL successor is now archived.
boundary_zh: 它复现已有研究产物，不评估新问题的选择；原始 harness 已停止维护，其推荐的 HAL 后续实现目前也已归档。

title: ScienceWorld: Is your Agent Smarter than a 5th Grader?
focus_en: Tests action-grounded scientific reasoning by requiring agents to conduct experiments and complete tasks in an interactive text environment.
focus_zh: 要求 agents 在交互式文本环境中开展实验并完成任务，用实际行动检验 scientific reasoning。
boundary_en: Tasks concern elementary science rather than frontier discovery, and version 1.3.0 changes simulation ordering and potentially trajectories, so comparisons must identify the environment version. The hosted demo could not be reached during the 2026-10-30 link check; the paper and code remain available.
boundary_zh: 任务覆盖基础科学而非前沿发现，且 1.3.0 改变了模拟对象顺序并可能影响轨迹，因此比较结果需注明环境版本。2026-10-30 链接检查未能连通在线 demo；论文与代码仍可访问。

title: SciCode: A Research Coding Benchmark Curated by Scientists
focus_en: Measures whether models can combine scientific knowledge, reasoning, and executable code on scientist-curated research problems with testable subproblems.
focus_zh: 用科学家整理的研究问题及可测试子问题，衡量模型结合科学知识、推理与可执行代码的能力。
boundary_en: Tests supplied coding problems rather than discovery significance; a 2026 SciCode-Verified audit reports specification and grading defects, so benchmark version and evaluation settings matter.
boundary_zh: 它测试给定编程问题而非发现的科学价值；2026 年 SciCode-Verified 审计报告了题目规范与评分缺陷，因此需区分 benchmark 版本与评估设置。

title: Many AI analysts, one dataset: Navigating the agentic data science multiverse
focus_en: Compares autonomous analyses of the same dataset and hypothesis across models and personas. Shows how analysis choices change conclusions and motivates reporting alternative analyses.
focus_zh: 比较不同模型和 persona 对同一数据集与假设的自主分析，展示分析选择如何改变结论，并主张报告不同分析路径。
boundary_en: The hypothesis and estimand are fixed across three datasets, and an AI auditor checks the analyses. This reveals analytic variation, not proof that every retained analysis is correct or that agents can choose worthwhile questions.
boundary_zh: 研究在三个数据集上固定假设与 estimand，并用 AI auditor 检查分析。它揭示分析差异，不能保证每个保留分析都正确，也未验证自主选题能力。
